pages.title: Token Standards
pages.description: Compare NEAR's smart contract standards for fungible tokens, NFTs, and MultiTokens.

pages.title: NEAR Native Token

pages.title: Validators
pages.description: Learn about NEAR Protocol validators, their roles in network security, consensus mechanisms, validator economics, and how to become a validator.

pages.title: Storage
pages.description: Learn about NEAR Protocol's storage staking mechanism, including costs, storage pricing, attack prevention, and strategies for managing on-chain data storage.
